html:
Anastasio Somoza García was the dictator of Nicaragua from 1936 until he was shot in 1956. He founded a family dynasty that ruled until 1979.

As head of the National Guard created during the American occupation, he had Sandino killed in 1934 and took the presidency two years later. He ruled through the Guard and his Liberal party, became the country's largest landowner and business owner, and kept close to the United States.

In 1956 the poet Rigoberto López Pérez shot him at a party in León, and he died days later. His sons Luis and Anastasio Somoza Debayle ruled after him. The family's greed, shown when aid after the Managua earthquake was stolen, united the country against them in the revolution of 1979 in Nicaragua.
